title.description: Retired in v1.0 (spec §4.5): deliverables are headed by trip-brief.headline. Kept optional so pre-v1.0 itineraries stay valid; renderers read it only when no brief is given.

items.description: A string item is the pre-v1.0 shape: still schema-valid, but the itinerary gate fails it (v1.0 spec §4.7).

must_do_coverage.description: Maps each trip-brief must_do theme (free text) to the verified-POI ids that satisfy it; itinerary-gate passes the theme when >=1 mapped id is scheduled. (P5)

contingency.description: Fallbacks per named trigger. itinerary-synthesis has always produced this section (SKILL.md calls it a Required derived section) but had no container, so it was hand-assembled into the markdown and a full re-render would silently lose it. (TW-069)

theme.description: 每日標題（≤13 字，含標點），使用者從 theme_candidates 挑的那句或自己寫的（theme_user_written）。Optional in schema; required by the itinerary gate (v1.0 §4.8, v1.1 topic 7).

theme_picked.description: The user picked this day's theme in the title picker (scripts/title_picks.py); a picker written again keeps it selected.

theme_user_written.description: The user wrote the theme themselves (title picker 自己寫); it then needs no candidate and no theme_refs.

theme_candidates.description: Six day-title candidates for the user to pick from, each one shape x one twist (v1.1 topic 7; rules in skills/itinerary-synthesis/references/day-titles.md, checked by scripts/day_titles.py). More come in batches of 3 when the user asks.

theme_refs.description: poi_ids of that day's stops the theme rests on (≥1).

alternatives.description: Per-stop 備案/選項 (v1.0, spec §4.4). Replaces trip-level contingency and inline ▸ rows. poi_id is deliberately not schema-required: a missing fallback place is a routed gate failure, not a schema failure.

applies_to.description: poi_id of the stop on this day the alternative hangs under.

poi_id.description: The fallback place; must be a verified POI (gate).

closing_status.description: Verdict synthesis computed via scripts/hours.py::closing_status for this row. Optional in schema for back-compat; required by the itinerary gate on every row carrying both a `time` and a resolving `poi_id`. Without it the closing-buffer iron rule (using-tripwork/SKILL.md:48) has no mechanical form.

leg_index.description: Index into legs.yaml's `legs` array that this move row renders. Optional in schema for back-compat; required by the itinerary gate's `home_legs_rendered` check for every `kind: home` leg — without a row referencing it by leg_index, a home leg's classify_leg verdict is checked and its fare is summed, but nothing proves it ever reached the reader. (TW-069)

mode.description: Move rows only: how this segment is travelled. `none` = same place (breakfast at the hotel). Optional in schema for back-compat; required by the itinerary gate on every move row without a leg_index (v1.0, spec §4.1).

mins.description: Move rows only: minutes for this segment. Required by the gate unless mode is none.

km.description: Move rows only: route km for this segment. Required by the gate unless mode is none; re-derived against the endpoints' straight-line distance by scripts/rederive.py::rederive_moves.

basis.description: Move rows only: `sourced` needs source_url, `estimated` needs estimate_method (rendered 估).
